analysis.one_line_summary: Creator demos the Wavytalk Power Wave Coachella bundle, styling her hair into Hailey Bieber-inspired festival waves in under 10 minutes.
analysis.full_description: A creator showcases an instant hair transformation using the Wavytalk Power Wave styling tool from the limited Main Stage Waves Coachella Bundle. She demonstrates setting the temperature to 360 degrees, styling sections until the automatic timer beeps, unboxing the bundle accessories including the Smooth Barrier heat protectant and festival merch, and shows a before-and-after split comparison of her straight hair versus voluminous wavy hair.

on_screen_text.text: WAVYTALK Smooth Barrier Heat Protectant Spray

scenes.visual: Creator winks at the camera with straight dark hair, cuts instantly to finished wavy hair.
scenes.action: Creator winks, followed by snap transition revealing bouncy textured waves.

scenes.visual: Creator holds up the peach/orange Wavytalk Power Wave iron displaying the digital temperature readout.
scenes.action: Points at the digital display screen showing 360°.

scenes.visual: Creator clamping a hair section inside the Power Wave curler.
scenes.action: Demonstrates inserting a strand into the waver until it beeps and releases a distinct deep wave.

scenes.visual: Extreme close-up of creator's wavy hair texture.
scenes.action: Touches shiny defined wave beside her cheek while showing an impressed facial expression.

scenes.visual: Creator holds the pink Main Stage Waves Coachella bundle box, then opens it to reveal contents.
scenes.action: Displays boxed set containing tool, heat protectant, clips, and accessories.

scenes.visual: Showcase of bundled merchandise: miniature waver keychain, Smooth Barrier spray, and festival scarf.
scenes.action: Creator holds up each merch item in front of camera.

scenes.visual: Creator holding the Power Wave tool talking directly to camera.
scenes.action: Explains testing the tool for Coachella festival durability.

scenes.visual: Photo of Hailey Bieber with wavy hair in background with creator in foreground picture-in-picture.
scenes.action: Creator points behind her to Hailey Bieber reference image.

scenes.visual: Creator holding and spraying Smooth Barrier heat protectant.
scenes.action: Sprays heat protectant evenly across a strand of straight hair.

scenes.visual: Creator shows split hairstyle: left side naturally straight, right side waved.
scenes.action: Smiles and points at the side-by-side contrast.

scenes.visual: Creator continuing to style remaining sections with the Power Wave.
scenes.action: Clamps iron down hair lengths from multiple angles.

scenes.visual: Creator turning around to display full back view of hair, then turning back to camera smiling.
scenes.action: Rakes fingers through waves, turns to show hair volume and shine, waves goodbye and exits frame.
